LRV_slot_lambda.conflict: frozen §6.2 rows 13/20 and JSON strategies.V2-LRV.slot_capital ('entire slot capital'; 'evolves with own P&L, costs and dividends; no cross-slot lending') vs frozen §8.4 single portfolio-wide lambda = min(1, K/(B*(1+s))) with K = total cash
LRV_slot_lambda.decision: for V2-LRV the §8.4 formula is applied per entering slot with K = that slot's own cash and B = its slot capital, i.e. lambda_slot = min(1, slot_cash/(B*(1+s))) = 1/(1+s) when B = slot_cash; the slot ends with zero cash; no cross-slot lending
LRV_slot_lambda.scope: V2-LRV only; V2-MOM, V2-STR, B1 and B2 use the global §8.4 lambda exactly as written

diagnostic_definitions.applies_to: non-gated §12 diagnostics whose exact formula the frozen text leaves open; none affects any trade, the economic gate (net CAGR @5 bps vs B1) or Gate C completeness
diagnostic_definitions.daily_returns: r_d = E(d)/E(d-1) - 1 for d = 1..N, E(0) = E_0 = 100000, E(N) = post-liquidation E_T (frozen §12)
diagnostic_definitions.max_drawdown: max over d of (1 - E(d)/max_{u<=d} E(u)) on the series [E_0, E(1..N-1), E_T] (the same series as r_d); reported as a positive fraction
diagnostic_definitions.worst_month: minimum over calendar months of prod(1 + r_d) - 1 over the month's sessions
diagnostic_definitions.worst_year: minimum over calendar years of prod(1 + r_d) - 1 over the year's sessions (2017 partial, labelled)
diagnostic_definitions.calendar_year_subperiods: per calendar year: return = prod(1+r_d)-1; CAGR = (1+return)^(252/n_y)-1; volatility, Sharpe, Sortino, max drawdown on that year's r_d slice (drawdown restarted at the year's start equity); B1/B2 return for the same slice; 2017 labelled partial (starts 2017-02-01)
diagnostic_definitions.position_episode: a maximal run of sessions over which a strategy holds a non-zero share quantity of one symbol (resizing does not break an episode)
diagnostic_definitions.episode_net_return: (sum of sell proceeds net of costs + dividends received + final mark value net of the liquidation cost if still held at segment end) / (sum of gross buy notional plus buy costs) - 1
diagnostic_definitions.episode_profit_factor: sum of positive episode P&L / |sum of negative episode P&L|; undefined if no losing episode
diagnostic_definitions.symbol_pnl_contribution: per symbol: sell proceeds net of costs + dividends + final net mark - gross buy notional - buy costs, over the segment
diagnostic_definitions.symbol_breadth: share of symbols ever held with symbol_pnl_contribution > 0
diagnostic_definitions.top2_concentration: sum of the two largest |symbol_pnl_contribution| / sum of all |symbol_pnl_contribution|
diagnostic_definitions.weight_hhi: time-averaged weights wbar_i = mean over sessions of shares_i*mark_i/E; renormalised p_i = wbar_i / sum_j wbar_j; HHI = sum p_i^2 (undefined if never invested)
diagnostic_definitions.exposure: daily sum_i shares_i*mark_i / E at each close (frozen §12); cash exposure = 1 - exposure
diagnostic_definitions.symbols_held: mean, min and max number of symbols with non-zero shares at each close; distinct symbols ever held
diagnostic_definitions.hac_tstat_active_vs_b1: a_d = r_d - r_d^B1; t = mean(a)/sqrt(V_NW/N), V_NW = gamma_0 + 2*sum_{l=1..5} (1 - l/6)*gamma_l with gamma_l = (1/N)*sum (a_d - mean)(a_{d-l} - mean) (Newey-West, Bartlett, lag 5); annualised active return = mean(a)*252
diagnostic_definitions.holm: Holm step-down adjusted p-values across the three families V2-MOM, V2-STR, V2-LRV for the same cost scenario (diagnostic only)
diagnostic_definitions.executions: count of opens with at least one fill (frozen); rebalances = count of scheduled decisions executed (A/B) or of cycles started (C)
diagnostic_definitions.trades: number of individual fills (buy or sell of one symbol at one open)
diagnostic_definitions.cost_per_execution: total costs / executions; undefined at 0 bps reported as 0
diagnostic_definitions.cost_drag: gross CAGR - net CAGR (5 and 10 bps)

pit_test_sample: deterministic, no randomness (frozen §11.12): every 10th decision session of each family's schedule in the Research segment, plus its first and last decision
